Gower Distance Model for Case-Based-Reasoning

Source: R/gower.R
GowerModel.Rd

Gower Distance Model for Case-Based-Reasoning

Gower Distance Model for Case-Based-Reasoning

Details

A model-free case base: the distance between cases is the Gower distance (gower_distance) of the variables on the right-hand side of the formula, optionally weighted. The endpoint (left-hand side) is not used for the distance, but for predict_outcome(), predict_survival(), evaluate() and counterfactual cases. Use it as a baseline for the model-derived distances of the other models, or with expert-defined weights.

Ranges of numeric variables are taken from the training cases, so that distances of query cases do not depend on each other.

References

Gower, J. C. (1971). A general coefficient of similarity and some of its properties. Biometrics, 27(4), 857–871. doi:10.2307/2528823

Object of class formula or character, e.g. y ~ . or Surv(time, status) ~ x1 + x2.

Examples

m <- GowerModel$new(Species ~ ., iris[-(1:3), ])
m$fit()
m$get_similar_cases(iris[1:3, ], k = 2)
#>    Sepal.Length Sepal.Width Petal.Length Petal.Width Species     scDist caseId
#> 18          5.1         3.5          1.4         0.3  setosa 0.01041667      1
#> 28          5.2         3.5          1.5         0.2  setosa 0.01118173      2
#> 35          4.9         3.1          1.5         0.2  setosa 0.01465395      1
#> 26          5.0         3.0          1.6         0.2  setosa 0.01541902      2
#> 48          4.6         3.2          1.4         0.2  setosa 0.01118173      1
#> 30          4.7         3.2          1.6         0.2  setosa 0.01271186      2
m$predict_outcome(iris[1:3, ], k = 5)
#>   prediction prob_setosa prob_versicolor prob_virginica
#> 1     setosa           1               0              0
#> 2     setosa           1               0              0
#> 3     setosa           1               0              0
